
## Native trailer resolver fallback and presentation fixes

- Add a pinned on-device yt-dlp metadata fallback when NewPipe fails or resolves below 4K. Probe higher alternate renditions before selecting the best playable URL. No video download, FFmpeg, external player or hosted backend is required.
- Preserve the existing decoder and PlayerView during inline-to-fullscreen expansion. Shared presentation ownership now hides navigation and masks consistently, including catalogue/grid screens without fullscreen callbacks.
- Record expansion requests and actual decoded video dimensions/codecs separately from requested quality in App Diagnostics.
- Bound fallback extraction to one metadata process at a time, with timeout/cancellation cleanup, no account cookies and no raw signed URLs in logs.
- Keep the runtime lazy; existing trailer/source prewarming still happens in the background. Adds the 32-bit Python/QuickJS runtime to the APK.

Best quality means the highest accessible rendition the device can play. YouTube client restrictions can still limit resolution or reject playback. Cold extraction and a consistent under-two-second start cannot be guaranteed. Physical-TV playback, expansion and memory/latency validation are still required.
